# Blanc Engine - Full AI Context & Documentation

Blanc Engine is a specialized open-source desktop visual novel studio designed for indie authors, scriptwriters, and game developers targeting Windows.

## Philosophy
Blanc Engine replaces traditional script-coding workflows (such as Python or custom scripting languages) with an intuitive node graph and visual inspector, making visual novel creation accessible to everyone without sacrificing depth.

## Core Capabilities
1. Screenplay Flowchart:
   Branching node system supporting Dialogue, Branch/Choice, Conditional logic, Set Variable, and Scene jumps.
2. Character System:
   Multiple character presets with interchangeable expressions, speaker positions, and portrait animations.
3. Audio System:
   BGM, BGS, and Voice-over channels with fading and volume normalization.
4. Visual Designer:
   In-engine visual customization of dialogue boxes, choice buttons, quick menus, title screens, save/load screens, and settings dialogs.
5. Windows Standalone Runtime:
   Built on robust native technologies delivering 60 FPS performance and lightweight memory usage.
6. Localization:
   Export and import dialogue strings via standard CSV for effortless multilingual support.
